integrity: Claims and proof are based on explicit counting identities, an exact finite certificate, and an analytic infinite-range inequality. Critical computations were executed on the accompanying standalone source. No independent mathematical validation or originality certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The cutoff is exact only for Ferroni's specifically defined one-parameter Gorenstein index-four Cayley family; it does not assert a global minimal dimension, a statement for arbitrary Cayley sums, or independent historical priority. The finite minor checks are exhaustive only for eleven explicitly bounded parameter values.
title: Sharp log-concavity transition in a Gorenstein Cayley family
